question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Retract
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Retract"** means to draw back or withdraw something previously stated or written. (वापस लेना)

 
 
• **Example: **The newspaper had to **retract** the story after it was found to be false.
 
 
 
• **"Revoke"** means to officially cancel or withdraw a decision, decree, or permission. (रद्द करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The government decided to **revoke** the new policy after facing widespread criticism.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'retract' **is **'revoke'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Implement** (लागू करना): To put a decision, plan, agreement, etc., into effect.

 
 
• **Example:** The new policy will be implemented from next month.
 
 
 
• **Disturb** (परेशान करना): To interrupt the peace or order of something.
 
 
• **Example:** Please do not disturb me while I am working.
 
 
 
• **Please** (कृपया): To make someone feel happy and satisfied.
 
 
• **Example:** She always tries to please her guests with delicious meals.
